defaults.x: Print Zine, Craft Workshop, Local Service Clear
defaults.d: none needed: orders and bookings arrive by email or a till
defaults.c: Colours taken from the food and the room, with a dark text colour that keeps small print readable
defaults.a: Book a table, order, or find us
defaults.t: Hygiene rating, allergen note, real photos of the place, named reviews with sources, opening hours stated for today
defaults.b: Table booking or pre-order; catering enquiries by form

rows: Restaurant/Food Service
restaurant, dining, menu, table, book, takeaway, chef, kitchen
Publish the menu as text with allergens, the booking link and today's hours before any story. Show your own plates and the room, and say how to reach you for large groups.
Bakery/Cafe
cafe, bakery, coffee, pastries, cake, brunch, baker, loaf
Today's hours, address and a few real products belong above the fold. Take orders for cakes and bulk by form, list allergens, and show what sells out early.

rows.a: Find us or order a cake

rows: Brewery/Winery
brewery, winery, beer, wine, tasting, tour, taproom, cellar door
Sell the visit: tasting times, tours and tickets, then the range. Show the age notice, a drinkaware line, and a stockist list for shops.

rows.c: Colours drawn from the vessels and labels, kept to two plus a neutral

rows: Caterer
caterer, catering, events, buffet, wedding food, corporate lunch, menu, quote
Offer sample menus with per-head prices and ask event date, guests and dietary needs in the quote form. Show your hygiene rating and insurance.

rows.b: Quote form with date, guests, venue and dietary needs; tasting booking

rows: Food Truck
food truck, street food, van, pitch, schedule, event catering, menu
The page must say where the truck is today and where it will be this week. Put the schedule in text, offer private hire by form, and show the menu.

rows.b: Private hire form with date, place and guests

rows: Farm Shop / Market Stall
farm shop, market stall, seasonal, local produce, boxes, veg box, collection
List what is in season this week and when it will be collected. Say where the produce is grown and keep the page quick on a poor signal.

rows.a: Reserve a box or see this week's stock

rows: Florist/Plant Shop
florist, flowers, bouquet, plants, wedding flowers, delivery, funeral, same day
Set delivery cut-off times and areas on the first screen. Offer set bouquets with price, and a phone number for sympathy and event work.
Hyperlocal Services
neighbourhood, local, nearby, community, services, directory, street, postcode
Anchor everything to a place: postcode search, neighbourhood names and real addresses. Keep listings checked by a person and say how often.

rows.t: Verified listings, date checked, local names
rows.b: Contact or book through each listing

rows: Subscription Box Service
subscription box, monthly box, curated, delivery, skip, gift, recurring, unboxing
Show what comes in a typical box, the price per month and how to skip or cancel. Make cancel as easy as joining, and show real box photos.

rows.d: Subscriber account with next box and skip
rows.t: Skip and cancel in one click, real box photos, delivery dates, returns
